archive_policy.rule: When the current phase is completed, move its full progress and validation evidence to the archive before creating a fresh progress.json for the next phase.

phase.title: Human Playtest and Core Feel
phase.goal: Package a reproducible Windows build, observe structured 3–8-player multi-PC sessions, and tune core feel from evidence before expansion.

milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.title: Reproducible Windows Playtest Build
milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.scope: Create a repeatable Windows export with build/version identification; verify standalone launch without adding distribution services.
milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.acceptance: Export twice from the same clean revision with matching payload hashes or documented packaging-only differences; launch on native Windows without editor/repository, with matching build identity and no missing resources. See docs/implementation-checklist.md for the executable plan.

milestone_2_2_playtest_readiness.title: Playtest Readiness
milestone_2_2_playtest_readiness.scope: Provide executable-based LAN instructions and validate exported settings/assets/audio, host/client readiness, movement, props, warnings, death/spectating, results, five rematches, disconnect/retry and physical LAN smoke before inviting a group.

milestone_2_3_human_playtest_baseline.title: Human Playtest Baseline
milestone_2_3_human_playtest_baseline.scope: Observe a 3–4-person session and a 6–8-person session on separate Windows PCs; aim for three normal rounds each and record actual counts, hardware/network/input/display setup, uncoached death explanations, warnings, camera/control/fairness issues, voluntary rematches and timestamped emergent causal chains.

milestone_2_4_core_feel_improvements.title: Core-Feel Improvements
milestone_2_4_core_feel_improvements.scope: Prioritize reproduced high-impact issues; tune existing movement/camera/warning/pacing owners one coherent change at a time and regress. Create tasks from actual findings, not speculative tuning. No new disasters, shove, map expansion or distribution services.

milestone_2_5_follow_up_validation_and_p.title: Follow-Up Validation and Phase Review
milestone_2_5_follow_up_validation_and_p.scope: Retest affected scenarios and normal rounds with humans at both group sizes; compare baseline and follow-up evidence. Report actual durations against the configurable 8–12-minute target. If criteria fail, remain in Phase 2 and return observed issues to 2.4 before repeating 2.5.

proposed_expansion_criteria.death_clarity: At least 80% of sampled deaths correctly explained without coaching; report numerator and denominator.
proposed_expansion_criteria.voluntary_rematches: A majority independently willing to rematch in each follow-up group; distinguish requested rounds from voluntary requests.
proposed_expansion_criteria.emergence: At least two distinct emergent causal patterns recurring across rounds.
proposed_expansion_criteria.stability: No unresolved session-blocking/control failures; recurring high-impact issues addressed with regression and human follow-up evidence. Small samples are product evidence, not statistical proof.
